interview.secured: The app never told me what "Day secured" means; I didn't see that phrase on the home screen or the photo viewer, so I'd only be guessing that it means I finished today's challenge.
interview.freeze: The app never explained a freeze to me, and I didn't see the word anywhere, so I can't say what it is here.
interview.selfReported: I never saw "Self-reported" on a task or any explanation of it, so I don't know what it means in this app.
interview.tomorrow: 5 - The home screen is clear, with a streak counter and a simple "Drink Water Today" start button, but I haven't started a challenge yet and the feed is just a black photo from a stranger, so nothing is pulling me back yet.

goals.text: You have used GRIIT for about a month. Open your profile and scroll through every one of your posts to the end. Then go to Home and compare the numbers: does the streak and the day number on Home match what your profile says? Say in your thought every number that does not match.
